newsitem.title: USA: Ohio school funding task force holds first meeting.
newsitem.headline: Ohio school funding task force holds first meeting.

text.p: Ohio Gov. George Voinovich's new task force on school funding issues met for the first time Tuesday to begin helping legislators address the inadequacies raised by the Ohio Supreme Court last month.
The task force members chose Greg Browning, Ohio budget and management director, to serve as chairman and pledged to meet weekly, said Kathie Fleck, a spokeswoman for Voinovich.
The Ohio Supreme Court on March 24 ruled Ohio's school funding system unconstitutional.

Voinovich has asked the state supreme court to reconsider its ruling and clarify parts of the decision, which upheld a lower court judge's findings. That request remains pending before the supreme court, which is not currently in session.

The task force mission statement provides that the group will "act promptly, and with inclusion, to achieve bi-partisan consensus on fiscally responsible recommendations for a permanent resolution" of the school funding case.
The Ohio Coalition for Equity and Adequacy of School Funding, which represents school districts that brought the lawsuit, plans to offer its own recommendations for overhauling the system next week.
